adapter.language_abi: Python 3 typed IR -> Pass213 governed native dispatch
adapter.origin_authority: Pass214 compatibility graph over Pass213 execution foundation

resolved_defects: scalar values are no longer reinterpreted as VM cell indexes
CELL_REF is explicit and fails closed without an exact compiled read admission
canonical mutations no longer call apply_instruction directly
canonical mutations inherit Pass213 Hash216 successor and Hash72 receipt closure
compiled native-dispatch identity is checked before mutation
multi-block control transfer no longer continues through a stale block pointer
call and return preserve an explicit continuation pair
register, target, operand, lane, timestamp, and access-set bounds are validated
legacy MUL DIV MOD QGU CONSTRAIN and projected-grid HASH72 operations are not silently promoted to canonical authority
Hash72 receipt observation is separated from projected grid identity

legacy_bridge_disposition.reason: Direct apply_instruction mutation bypasses the Pass213 governed admission and receipt authority; source is preserved because the frozen blob is an inherited authority.

notes: This adapter does not claim to parse Python source or Python bytecode.
Python/source frontends may lower into this IR only after their own deterministic parsing and validation layer.
Unsupported legacy operations require exact compiled-ROM/native-dispatch admission before they can become canonical mutations.
